rows.tile.FORGE.hint: Bump it to fuse motes, craft sigils or enchant and upgrade gear.
rows.tile.SHRINE.hint: Bump it to learn about the god, swear to them or pray.
rows.tile.ICE_DOOR.hint: Fire melts it. Blows crack it slowly.
rows.tile.THORNS.hint: Fire clears it; pushing through hurts.
rows.tile.TOLL.hint: Costs half your current HP to pass. Real treasure behind.
rows.tile.SEALED.hint: Something on this floor opens it. Bump it for a clue.
rows.tile.STAIRS.hint: Leads down to the next floor.
rows.tile.EXIT.hint: Opens when the floor boss falls.
rows.tile.STAIRS_UP.hint: Leads back up to the floor above.
rows.tile.PORTAL.hint: A doorway between worlds. Step in to cross over.
rows.tile.CHEST.enhanced: Contains two equipment items, each raised one quality tier, up to the highest tier.
rows.tile.CHEST.greedy: One of two gold chests. The floor around their platforms looks unstable.
rows.tile.EXIT.open: Open. Step through to go on.
rows.tile.EXIT.sealed: Sealed. Bring {boss}'s {core} here to open it.
rows.status.blind.hero: Only adjacent squares are visible. Attacks miss far more often.
rows.buff.laststand.hero: Damage taken −{cut}%. Regenerate up to {regen} HP per turn.
rows.status.discipline.hero: Weapon damage +{damage}. Crit +{crit}%. Armor +{armour}. Taking HP damage adds a stack and reduces remaining cooldowns by 1, once per turn.
rows.buff.forge-heat.card: Weapon damage +{damage} and armor +{armour}. Each landed hit adds a stack.
rows.warn.warden.judgment: Judgment: damage dealt returns in 3 turns. Break sight!
rows.warn.matron.venom: Venom falling: leave the red tiles!
rows.warn.storm-charge: Storm Beetle charging: leave its lane!
rows.warn.shock-eel: Shock Eel charging: leave the water!
rows.monster.goblin.lore: A goblin armed with a stolen blade.
rows.monster.brute.lore: An armored goblin that pushes adjacent foes back.
rows.monster.brute.hint: Heavy armor. Melee hits can push you back. 4-turn cooldown.
rows.monster.slime.lore: Spits sticky gravel that Roots its target for 2 turns.
rows.monster.slime.hint: Heals 2 HP per turn. Splits when hit at full health. Spits roots.
rows.monster.pebbleslime.lore: A small slime of loose pebbles.
rows.monster.pebbleslime.hint: Marks a tile before striking. Move off the mark.
rows.monster.shaman.lore: Throws firebolts, heals goblin allies and grants them Rage.
rows.monster.skeleton.hint: Bone Rush: charges from up to 3 tiles away along a clear path, then makes a normal attack. Recovers for 4 turns.
rows.monster.mimic.lore: A predator disguised as a chest.
rows.monster.warchief.lore: Grukk, chief of the dungeon goblins.
rows.monster.emberling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Burning on a landed attack.
rows.monster.tideling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Chill on a landed attack.
rows.monster.galeling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Stun on a landed attack.
rows.monster.stoneling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Poison on a landed attack.
rows.monster.wisp.hint: 30% chance to inflict Fear on a landed attack.
rows.monster.lumenling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Blind on a landed attack.
rows.monster.shambler.lore: Its hits inflict Rot. Rises once after death unless killed by fire or light, or while Burning.
rows.monster.gravebeetle.lore: Releases poison gas when attacked at close range.
rows.monster.bonearcher.lore: Fires poison-tipped arrows, then spends a turn reloading.
rows.monster.shade.lore: Passes through thin walls. Its touch Chills and drains mana.
rows.monster.gravebloat.lore: Its hits inflict Rot. Bursts into poison gas on death.
rows.monster.acolyte.lore: Summons a Skeleton and gives undead allies Bone Ward, which blocks one hit.
rows.monster.acolyte.hint: Summons Skeletons and wards allies. Attacks cause Fear for 1 turn.
rows.monster.morty.lore: Reforms while his phylactery survives. Destroy it to stop his return.
rows.monster.phylactery.lore: Keeps Morty alive. Destroy it to prevent his resurrection.
rows.monster.dawnsentinel.lore: Halves spell and ranged damage, then returns 4 damage on direct hits. Your defenses reduce the returned damage.
rows.monster.prismscarab.lore: A beetle that splits its light beam between targets.
rows.monster.radiantwarden.lore: An armored guardian of the light realm.
rows.monster.stalker.lore: A shadow predator that ambushes from darkness.
rows.monster.gloommoth.lore: A moth that snuffs out light.
rows.monster.umbralhound.lore: A hound of the shadow realm.
rows.monster.mosstroll.lore: A regenerating troll covered in moss.
rows.monster.mountainheart.lore: A stone giant empowered by crystal nodes.
rows.monster.crystalnode.lore: A crystal that protects the Heart of the Mountain.
rows.monster.stormbeetle.lore: Charges down a marked lane and leaves a shock cloud. Its hits arc between nearby Storm Beetles.
rows.monster.sparkjelly.lore: Hurls electric bolts. Its sting chains to nearby creatures.
rows.monster.shockeel.lore: Electrifies marked water around it. Leave the charged water before it strikes.
rows.monster.myconid.lore: Lobs poisonous spore clouds that Slow you and summons Shroomlings. Closes to melee at short range.
rows.monster.wormtender.lore: A myconid that tends the Deep Maw's tunnels.
rows.monster.wormtender.hint: Summoned by the Deep Maw. Spore clouds poison and slow creatures inside.
rows.monster.crystalcrawler.lore: Spits sticky gravel that Roots its target for 2 turns.
rows.monster.crystalcrawler.hint: Heals 2 HP per turn. Splits when hit at full health. Spits roots.
rows.monster.rootbound.lore: Casts Earth Root, then closes in to strike while the spell recovers.
rows.monster.rootbound.hint: Casts Earth Root, then closes in to strike while the spell recovers.
rows.monster.cavebat.lore: A pale bat of the deep caverns.
rows.monster.caveslime.lore: Spits sticky gravel that Roots its target for 2 turns.
rows.monster.caveslime.hint: Heals 2 HP per turn. Splits when hit at full health. Spits roots.
rows.monster.deepmaw.lore: A giant worm tunneling beneath the Caverns.
rows.monster.deepmaw.hint: Each eruption summons a Worm Tender by a burrow mound. Maximum 1 Tender alive.
rows.monster.cinderling.lore: A fire elemental of the Caverns.
rows.monster.cinderling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Burning on a landed attack.
rows.monster.rippleling.lore: A water elemental of the Caverns.
rows.monster.rippleling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Chill on a landed attack.
rows.monster.gustling.lore: An air elemental of the Caverns.
rows.monster.gustling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Stun on a landed attack.
rows.monster.mossling.lore: An earth elemental of the Caverns.
rows.monster.mossling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Poison on a landed attack.
rows.monster.duskling.lore: A shadow elemental of the Caverns.
rows.monster.duskling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Fear on a landed attack.
rows.monster.gleamling.lore: A light elemental of the Caverns.
rows.monster.gleamling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Blind on a landed attack.
rows.monster.pyreling.lore: A great fire elemental of the Underdark.
rows.monster.pyreling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Burning on a landed attack.
rows.monster.tideling3.lore: A great water elemental of the Underdark.
rows.monster.tideling3.hint: 30% chance to inflict Chill on a landed attack.
rows.monster.stormling.lore: A great air elemental of the Underdark.
rows.monster.stormling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Stun on a landed attack.
rows.monster.cragling.lore: A great earth elemental of the Underdark.
rows.monster.cragling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Poison on a landed attack.
rows.monster.umbraling.lore: A great shadow elemental of the Underdark.
rows.monster.umbraling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Fear on a landed attack.
rows.monster.dawnling.lore: A great light elemental of the Underdark.
rows.monster.dawnling.hint: 30% chance to inflict Blind on a landed attack.
rows.monster.drowblade.lore: A drow duelist who waits in stealth.
rows.monster.drowpriestess.lore: A drow caster who heals and wards allies.
rows.monster.thoughteater.lore: A creature that feeds on minds.
rows.monster.emberspider.lore: A spider with a burning bite.
rows.monster.matron.lore: Ruler of the Underdark's spider brood.
rows.monster.cinderimp.lore: An imp of the fire realm.
rows.monster.magmacrawler.lore: An armored crawler healed by fire.
rows.monster.magmacrawler.hint: Fire restores its health, including burning ground.
rows.monster.tidecrab.hint: Blocks the first hit each turn until its shell breaks after 3 blocks.
rows.monster.siren.lore: A singer of the water realm.
rows.monster.leviathaneel.lore: A giant eel of the water realm.
rows.monster.windwisp.lore: A wind spirit of the floating ruins.
rows.monster.sporecaller.lore: Marks a mushroom field that Roots, poisons and sprouts Shroomlings. Heals and shields nearby allies.
rows.monster.sporecaller.hint: Marks a root-and-poison field that sprouts two Shroomlings. Retreats, heals allies and grants Sporecoat.
rows.monster.greenslime.hint: Heals 2 HP per turn. Splits when hit at full health. Leaves poison for 10 turns: 1 damage per turn.
rows.monster.ghoul.lore: An undead ambusher that waits buried beneath the Crypt floor.
rows.monster.ghoul.hint: Emerges behind you and pursues quickly. Hits cause Bleed: 2 HP per turn for 3 turns. Healing stops it.
rows.monster.chaos-prism-seer.lore: A crystal-eyed caster of the Archives.
rows.monster.chaos-folded-horror.lore: A warped creature of the Archives.
rows.monster.chaos-rift-skitter.lore: A predator that moves through rifts.
rows.monster.chaos-lens-bearer.lore: A support caster who shields allies and fires light beams.
rows.monster.chaos-plague-bloat.lore: A plague-bearing creature of the Rot Hollows.
rows.monster.chaos-plague-bloat.hint: Leaves poison for 10 turns: 6 damage per turn.
rows.monster.chaos-brood-carrier.lore: Throws tiny plague-bearing offspring beside its target.
rows.monster.chaos-rotling.lore: A tiny plague-bearing creature of the Rot Hollows.
rows.monster.chaos-horned-reaver.lore: An axe-wielding fighter of the Cinder Bastion.
rows.monster.chaos-gorehound.lore: A hunting beast of the Cinder Bastion.
rows.monster.chaos-chain-reaver.lore: A Bastion fighter wielding a hooked chain.
rows.monster.chaos-lash-dancer.lore: A lash-wielding fighter of the violet courts.
rows.monster.chaos-razor-dancer.lore: A duelist of the violet courts.
rows.monster.chaos-silk-weaver.lore: Throws Spiderlings beside its target and weaves webs.
rows.monster.chaos-hookfang.lore: A fanged guardian of the silk warrens.
rows.monster.chaos-spiderling.lore: A tiny Spiderling of the violet groves.
rows.monster.unmaker-tyrant.hint: Keeps up to 3 Chaos demons at its side in every form. Shoulder Rush carries it up to 4 tiles toward you. Great Cleave marks the ground up to 2 tiles in front of it: circle its flank. It shrugs off Fear and Stun, but Blind, Root and Slow still work.
rows.monster.unmaker-unbound.hint: Three floating Prism Pylons each mark a line and fire down it 2 turns later; the beam does not follow you. The Unbound takes turns casting Rupture and Inversion Pulse, and demons keep coming. Step off the marked tiles or behind cover. The pylons float, so they never block your way. It shrugs off Fear and Stun.
rows.monster.unmaker-heart.hint: Keeps up to 3 Chaos demons at its side in every form. Discord Pulse strikes the inner ring first, then the outer ring. You get a turn to move before each: step out, then back in. It shrugs off Fear and Stun.
rows.monster.shade-swarm.lore: Passes through thin walls. Its touch Chills and drains mana.
rows.item.weapon.dagger: 10% faster attacks; +20% surprise damage; fits the off hand
rows.item.weapon.wand: spells cost less mana; a little spell damage
rows.item.weapon.bow: up close, your main weapon swings instead
rows.item.weapon.staff: the most spell damage and +1 spell range
rows.item.weapon.spear: reach: attacks 2 tiles away in a line
rows.item.armour.shirt: Bright flowers, bold colors and absolutely no armor.
rows.item.offhand.buckler: light shield; deflects more with upgrades
rows.item.offhand.camera: takes a lovely picture; does nothing else
rows.item.ring.mending: Extra HP regeneration while fed and not poisoned.
rows.item.ring.sustenance: You get hungry more slowly, and food buffs last much longer.
rows.item.ring.warding: Resistance to fire, frost, lightning, poison, light and shadow.
rows.item.ring.keeneyes: Spot traps and hidden doors more easily.
rows.item.ring.keeneyes.cursed: Makes traps and hidden doors harder to discover.
rows.item.amulet.hook: Pull an enemy to you, or yourself to an obstacle.
rows.item.amulet.hook.note: Cannot pull bosses. Crosses chasms and water. Range grows with the amulet: 5, 6, then 7 tiles.
rows.item.amulet.swap: Trade places with a visible creature.
rows.item.amulet.swap.note: Takes no time. Cannot move bosses. Range grows with the amulet: 4, 5, then 6 tiles.
rows.item.amulet.tide: Flood ground, wash away hazards and push enemies from the center.
rows.item.amulet.tide.note: Takes no time. Clears Burning and webs. Triggers every trap in the target room. Pushes 2 tiles at level III.
rows.item.amulet.seeking: Reveal terrain, traps and hidden doors.
rows.item.amulet.seeking.note: Grows with the amulet: 8, 12, then 16 tiles.
rows.item.amulet.pillar: Raise a pillar that blocks movement and sight.
rows.item.amulet.pillar.note: Grows with the amulet: 5, 10, then 15 turns.
rows.item.amulet.stillness.note: Any other action ends Stillness. Grows with the amulet: 3, 4, then 5 steps.
rows.item.amulet.echo.note: Consumes no additional sigil. Two-mote sigils at level II, the rest at level III. Never Ascension or Wisdom.
rows.item.amulet.thorns: Root yourself and reflect melee damage.
rows.item.amulet.thorns.note: Includes damage to your Ward, Mana Ward and Ice Armor. The ward grows with the amulet: 35%, 45%, then 55% of max HP.
rows.item.amulet.plenty.note: The chance grows with the amulet: 33% at I, 67% at II, always at III.
rows.item.food.honeycake: Regenerate 1% max HP per turn for 60 turns.
rows.item.food.moontart: Recover an extra 0.9% of max Mana per turn for 60 turns.
rows.item.food.figs: You move, attack and cast 30% faster for 20 turns.
rows.item.food.skewer: Poison cannot hurt you for 60 turns.
rows.item.food.graveplum: Take 50% less shadow damage for 60 turns.
rows.item.food.glowstew: Increase light radius; take 50% less lightning damage for 60 turns.
rows.item.food.emberpepper: Take 50% less fire damage for 60 turns.
rows.item.food.starfruit: Take 20% less elemental damage for 60 turns.
rows.passive.race.fae.text: Start with 1 affinity in your court's element. +1 affinity cap.
rows.passive.race.gloomling.text: Start with Shadow 1. +1 affinity cap, 20% less hunger. Take 25% more light damage.
rows.element.fire.rank6: When a Burning enemy dies, its fire leaps to the nearest enemy within 3 tiles. Fire spells leave flames for 3 turns. Immune to fire.
rows.element.water.rank6: Three Chills freeze an enemy instead of four. Water spells leave icy ground that Chills for 3 turns. Immune to frost.
rows.element.air.rank6: 15% of your attacks and spells take no time; lightning damage has a 15% stun chance. Immune to lightning.
rows.element.earth.rank6: Rooting a rooted enemy turns it to stone for 2 turns. Earth spells leave grasping roots for 3 turns. Immune to poison.
rows.element.light.rank6: Your light spells and Smites bless the ground for 3 turns. On it, you and your allies heal 2% of max HP a turn and resist all but physical damage; enemies take light damage, undead most of all. Immune to light.
rows.element.shadow.rank6: Your shadow damage Hollows enemies for 5 turns, up to 5 stacks. Each stack makes them take 5% more damage and lose 1 armor. Immune to shadow.
rows.combo.fire-earth: Taking ranged or spell damage Roots the attacker for 3 turns and inflicts Burning. Bosses: Root 1 turn.
rows.combo.fire-air: Your critical weapon and spell hits inflict Burning for 3 turns.
rows.combo.fire-light: Applying or refreshing Burning also Blinds the enemy for that application's duration.
rows.combo.fire-shadow: Your surprise weapon and spell hits inflict Burning and Corruption for 3 turns.
rows.combo.water-air: Chill from your weapon or spell hits arcs half the landed hit as lightning to up to 2 nearby foes within 4 tiles. Ground and non-damaging Chill do not arc.
rows.combo.water-earth: Rooted enemies gain a Chill stack each turn they stay rooted.
rows.combo.water-light: Your weapon and spell hits against Frozen enemies deal 25% of the landed damage again as Holy damage. Holy resistance applies.
rows.combo.water-shadow: Attacks and spells against Chilled enemies count as surprise attacks.
rows.combo.air-fire: Your weapon and spell hits against Burning enemies are critical hits. Accuracy still applies.
rows.combo.air-shadow: Your weapon and spell hits against Stunned enemies are critical hits. Accuracy still applies.
rows.combo.air-water: Your damage arcs leave frozen ground under each enemy hit for 3 turns. Grounded foes gain Chill each turn.
rows.combo.air-light: Your critical weapon and single-target spell hits Blind for 2 turns.
rows.combo.earth-fire: Weapon and single-target spell hits grant +2 damage and armor (max 5 stacks). Expires after 3 turns without a hit.
rows.combo.earth-light: Applying or refreshing Root also Blinds for that application's duration.
rows.combo.earth-water: Max Ice Armor +3 per Earth point. Your weapon hits restore 9 Ice Armor, up to its maximum.
rows.combo.light-fire: Your Smites set the target Burning.
rows.combo.light-water: Healing beyond your max HP becomes Ice Armor (up to its max).
rows.combo.light-earth: Your Smites Root ranged attackers and casters for 2 turns. Bosses: 1 turn.
rows.combo.shadow-fire: When a Burning enemy dies, become Hidden for 3 turns.
rows.combo.shadow-water: Surprise attacks Freeze the target at once (bosses: 2 Chill stacks).
rows.combo.shadow-air: Your surprise weapon and spell hits Stun for 2 turns. Bosses: 1 turn.
rows.combo.shadow-earth: Your surprise weapon and spell hits deal 25% of the landed damage again as Poison and Poison for 3 turns. Poison resistance and immunity apply.
rows.sigil.firestorm: Deal fire damage to enemies within 3 tiles and Burn them for 3 turns. Ignite nearby ground.
rows.sigil.identify: Identify all carried sigils and one chosen piece of gear. Extinguish fires within 3 tiles.
rows.sigil.levitate: Clear roots and webs. Float for 25 turns: cross chasms and water; ignore roots, webs, floor traps and ground hazards.
rows.sigil.stoneskin: Clear Poison and Stun. Gain Stone Skin for 15 turns: immunity to Poison, Stun and poison damage, plus physical protection.
rows.sigil.heal: Heal yourself, then recover more HP each turn for 15 turns.
rows.sigil.vanish: Vanish for 5 turns; enemies lose track of you.
rows.sigil.firestorm2: Deal fire damage to visible enemies within 4 tiles and Burn them for 4 turns. Ignite nearby ground.
rows.sigil.identify2: Identify all sigils and carried or equipped gear. Extinguish fires within 5 tiles.
rows.sigil.levitate2: Clear roots and webs. Float for 60 turns: cross chasms and water; ignore roots, webs, floor traps and ground hazards. Move, attack and cast 30% faster for the first 10 turns.
rows.sigil.haste: Move, attack and cast 30% faster for 20 turns.
rows.sigil.stoneskin2: Clear Poison and Stun. Gain a shield and Stone Skin for 30 turns: immunity to Poison, Stun and poison damage, plus physical protection.
rows.sigil.heal2: Heal to full and cleanse harmful statuses.
rows.sigil.vanish2: Vanish for 10 turns; enemies lose track of you.
rows.sigil.cinder: Move, attack and cast 50% faster for 10 turns, leaving fire where you step.
rows.sigil.magma: Ignite ground within 2 tiles for 5 turns and Burn nearby enemies for 3 turns. Your attacks and single-target spells deal +5 fire damage for 5 turns.
rows.sigil.sunburst: Deal light damage to all visible enemies and Blind them for 3 turns.
rows.sigil.smoke: Fill the room with smoke for 12 turns. Sight through smoke is limited to 1 tile. Enemies beyond 1 tile lose track of you and can be surprised.
rows.sigil.storm: Strike the 3 nearest visible enemies with lightning. Wet targets take extra damage; each hit has a 50% chance to Stun for 1 turn. Then make all visible enemies Wet for 5 turns.
rows.sigil.mire: Root enemies within 3 tiles for 3 turns and make them Wet for 6 turns.
rows.sigil.purify: Heal yourself, cleanse harmful statuses and remove curses from all equipped gear.
rows.sigil.mana: Restore mana and gain extra mana regeneration for 20 turns.
rows.sigil.recall: Teleport to this floor's stairs or open gate.
rows.sigil.blink: Teleport to a random spot you can see, 3 to 6 tiles away.
rows.sigil.rot: Permanently destroy one equipped item with a known curse.
rows.sigil.aegis: Clear Poison and Stun. Gain a shield and Stone Skin for 15 turns: immunity to Poison, Stun and poison damage, plus physical protection.
rows.sigil.naturesbounty: Conjure a Honeycake, a Mushroom Skewer and a Moonberry Tart nearby. Requires 3 empty tiles.
rows.sigil.ascension: Raise one piece of gear by +1, up to +3. A cursed item is cleansed instead.
rows.sigil.transmutation: Replace a carried or equipped item with another of the same type. Keeps quality, upgrades, enchantment and curse.
rows.sigil.wisdom: Gain 1 level, up to level 20. Keep your current XP progress.
rows.prayer.ironhide: Gain armor and a shield for 12 turns. Instant.
rows.prayer.pummel: Your next 3 unarmed hits deal bonus damage and Stun for 1 turn. Instant.
rows.prayer.rampage: Gain melee damage and attack speed for 10 turns. Instant.
rows.prayer.trollblood: Restore HP, cleanse harmful statuses and regenerate HP for 6 turns.
rows.prayer.consecrate: Cleanse yourself and deal light damage to every undead and shadow creature within 3 tiles. Instant.
rows.prayer.sanctuary: Bless the ground within 3 tiles for 10 turns and Fear enemies there for 4 turns. Heal allies and damage enemies.
rows.prayer.laststand: Reduce incoming damage and regenerate HP for 5 turns. Instant.
rows.prayer.rolldice2: Tempt Wobbles for a greater reward, or a nastier prank.
rows.prayer.raisedead: Summon one undead servant until destroyed or you leave the floor.
rows.prayer.the-brood: Summon up to 3 spiderlings for 30 turns. Their bites web or poison.
rows.prayer.venom-burst: Deal poison damage to enemies within 3 tiles, then Poison and Blind for 3 turns.
rows.prayer.fieldsmelt: Recycle one carried item for full essence value. Instant.
rows.prayer.anviltoll: Attack all enemies within 2 tiles. Hits knock back 2 tiles and Stun for 1 turn.
rows.prayer.lance: Attack enemies in a 3-tile-wide beam within 3 tiles with your main hand.
rows.prayer.bonespear: Deal shadow damage to every enemy in a line up to 6 tiles long. Costs 5 HP.
rows.prayer.manaward: Gain a shield for 8 turns. Each HP absorbed restores 1 Mana. Instant.
rows.prayer.luckystreak: Retry one failed combat roll per turn for 8 turns. Instant.
rows.prayer.arcaneblink: Teleport to a visible, empty walkable tile within 5 tiles.
rows.status.poison: Takes damage every turn and doesn't regenerate.
rows.status.bleed: Loses HP every turn. Any healing stops it.
rows.status.chill: Acts more slowly; takes more frost damage.
rows.status.frozen: Cannot act; 0 evasion. Damage ends Freeze. Physical hits deal double damage.
rows.status.web: Cannot move; 0 evasion. Movement and action speed halved after release.
rows.buff.into-the-dark: While Hidden, your next weapon hit or single-target spell deals more damage.
rows.status.dazed: Cannot move or act; takes 50% more damage.
rows.status.fear: Flees; skips its action if trapped.
rows.status.wet: Takes more lightning damage and less fire damage.
rows.status.corrupt: Takes 25% more shadow damage. If you kill it, its shade may rise to serve you.
rows.status.hollow: Takes more damage from every source and has less armor, more with each stack.
rows.status.rot: No HP regeneration. Healing is halved.
rows.status.stone-skin: Immune to Poison, poison damage and Stun. -3 physical damage per hit. Clears Poison and Stun on use.
rows.status.petrified: Can't move or act. Evasion is 0.
rows.status.aura: Enemies within 2 tiles take shadow damage each turn, healing you for each enemy hit.
rows.status.livingmountain: +2% crit, +2% accuracy and +2 damage per stack (max 10). Unarmed attacks add and refresh stacks, even on misses.
rows.status.discipline: Weapon damage, crit and armor increased.
rows.status.goblinrage: +30% movement and action speed for 4 turns.
rows.status.sporecoat: Absorbs damage for up to 3 turns.
rows.status.chaoslens: Absorbs damage for up to 4 turns.
rows.status.chaosbrace: Stationary; takes 45% less damage for 2 turns.
rows.status.boneward: A Necro-Acolyte's ward blocks the next damaging hit.
rows.buff.rampage: More melee damage and faster melee attacks.
rows.buff.ironbody: Extra armor, and your unarmed hits may Stun.
rows.buff.manaward: Absorbed damage restores Mana, up to your maximum.
rows.buff.luckystreak: Retry one failed combat roll per turn.
rows.buff.thorns: Enemies that hit you in melee take half the damage back.
rows.buff.haste: Movement, attacks and spellcasting are 30% faster.
rows.buff.cinder: Faster, leaving fire where you step.
rows.buff.moltenring: Attacks and single-target spells deal 5 additional fire damage.
rows.buff.manaflow: Recover an extra 0.9% of max Mana each turn.
rows.status.sapped: Your hits on it always crit. It cannot be stunned again.
rows.buff.dawn: Every foe on the floor is shown.
rows.buff.forge-heat: Weapon damage +2 and armor +2 per stack. Each landed hit adds a stack.
rows.buff.regeneration: Heals 1% of your maximum HP each turn.
rows.buff.stormward: Your light reaches farther, and lightning damage is halved.
rows.timer.hidden: Enemies can't see you; your next hit is a surprise attack.
rows.timer.levitate: Cross chasms and water; ignore roots, webs, floor traps and ground hazards. Clears roots and webs on use.
rows.timer.stillness: Moving costs no time for the remaining steps. Attacking or any other action ends Stillness.
rows.timer.resolve: Immune to Stun, Root, Freeze and knockback.
rows.timer.stormform: Movement and action time halved. Instant cast.
rows.timer.wizardhunter: After being hurt by magic, elemental damage or a ranged attack, movement and attacks are faster for 3 turns.
rows.status.tomb: Sealed in ice: cannot act or be targeted, and statuses pause. When it ends you heal 25% of max HP and Mana.
rows.god.wobbles.passive: Wobbles may grant gifts, restore your strength or play a prank.
rows.step.name: Name your adventurer
rows.race.human.summary: Versatile adventurers, suited to any class.
rows.race.human.blurb: +{races:human.mods.mig} to all stats. +1 stat point every {races:human.statPointEvery} levels. +{races:human.passive.0.pct}% piety gain.
rows.race.elf.summary: Swift and gifted, suited to Mages and Scoundrels.
rows.race.elf.blurb: +{races:elf.speed|over100}% speed. Spells cost {races:elf.passive.0.mult|less}% less mana. +{races:elf.passive.1.add} range for ranged attacks and spells.
rows.race.dwarf.summary: Strong and tough, suited to Fighters and Clerics.
rows.race.dwarf.blurb: Weapons and armor gain one effective upgrade. No heavy armor evasion penalty. Forge upgrades cost {races:dwarf.passive.0.mult|less}% less.
rows.race.fae.summary: Elemental specialists, suited to Scoundrels and Mages.
rows.race.fae.blurb: Every Fae belongs to one of four courts, chosen next. Your court gives you {courts:ember.startingAffinity.fire} affinity in its element, and its own weakness. +{races:fae.affinityCapBonus} affinity cap.
rows.race.fae.after: Start with {courts:ember.startingAffinity.fire} affinity in your court's element. +{races:fae.affinityCapBonus} affinity cap. Takes 25% more damage from %weak.
rows.race.gloomling.summary: Hardy Shadow specialists, suited to Mages and Clerics.
rows.race.gloomling.blurb: Start with {races:gloomling.startingAffinity.shadow} Shadow affinity. +{races:gloomling.affinityCapBonus} affinity cap, {races:gloomling.passive.0.pct|abs}% less hunger. Take 25% more light damage.
rows.class.fighter.summary: Tough melee fighters. Primary stat: Might.
rows.class.fighter.passive: 12% max HP shield; refills out of combat
rows.class.cleric.summary: Devout fighters bound to their god and its favored fighting style.
rows.class.cleric.passive: Rank 1, 20 starting piety and +25% piety gain
rows.class.mage.summary: Spellcasters who grow with elemental affinity. Primary stat: Focus.
rows.class.scoundrel.summary: Fast, stealthy fighters with elemental tricks. Primary stat: Agility.
rows.class.scoundrel.passive: Double surprise damage; half enemy detection chance and {classes:scoundrel.noticeBandCut} tiles less detection range
rows.class.tourist.summary: Here for a good time, not a long time.
rows.class.tourist.passive: +{classes:tourist.passive.0.pct}% XP; +{classes:tourist.startingStatPoints} stat point at creation and every {classes:tourist.statPointEvery} levels
rows.invoke.name: Invoke
rows.invoke.text: Varies by god: the god you swear to grants your divine ability.
rows.cleric.bound: A Cleric can never switch gods.
rows.god.grom.rule: No Dwarves. Equip only Holy Symbols, rings and amulets.
rows.god.grom.favors: Favors unarmed Fighters who trust flesh over steel.
rows.god.grom.piety: Damaging unarmed hits, plus kills while your hands are empty; elites and bosses grant extra.
rows.god.grumbok.blurb: God of martial strength who forbids spellcasting.
rows.god.grumbok.favors: Favors Fighters and weapon combat; rejects spellcasting.
rows.god.grumbok.piety: Kills, extra for spellcasters and elemental creatures.
rows.god.glimmer.rule: No Shadow affinity, enchantments, spells or sigils. Requires room for Light affinity.
rows.god.glimmer.favors: Favors Light affinity, healing and smiting the undead.
rows.god.glimmer.piety: Kills, extra for undead and shadow creatures.
rows.god.murk.blurb: Patron of life drain and undead servants.
rows.god.murk.rule: No Light: no Light affinity, enchantments, spells or sigils.
rows.god.murk.favors: Favors Gloomlings, Shadow affinity and undead servants.
rows.god.murk.piety: Kills of the living, extra for kills by your undead.
rows.god.reginald.blurb: Patron of open combat and challenges.
rows.god.reginald.rule: Wake enemies within 8 tiles. No Scoundrels or Shadow affinity, enchantments, spells or sigils.
rows.god.reginald.favors: Favors Fighters who meet their enemies head-on.
rows.god.reginald.piety: Kills of enemies that see you coming, extra for elites and bosses.
rows.god.anvil.favors: Favors Dwarves, forged gear and enchanted weapons.
rows.god.anvil.piety: Spending essence anywhere, and enchanting or upgrading gear at the Forge.
rows.god.vellum.blurb: Patron of spellcasting and arcane equipment.
rows.god.vellum.rule: No shields, bows, staves or other two-handed weapons, and no armor heavier than leather.
rows.god.vellum.favors: Favors Mages and Elves devoted to spellcasting.
rows.god.vellum.piety: Spell kills and mana spent on spells or invocations earn Piety and Favor. Mana globes earn Piety.
rows.god.wobbles.blurb: God of luck, rewards and pranks.
rows.god.wobbles.favors: Favors risk-takers of every class; fortune is never certain.
rows.god.wobbles.piety: Kills and new floors earn Piety. Wobbles may grant gifts, restore your strength or play a prank.
rows.god.sylla.blurb: Patron of webs, poison and ambushes.
rows.god.sylla.rule: No Fire: no Fire affinity, enchantments, spells or sigils, and nothing set alight. No shields, and nothing heavier than leather.
rows.god.sylla.favors: Favors Scoundrels, stealth and lingering status effects.
rows.god.sylla.piety: Kills of the webbed, the rooted and the poisoned, and every surprise attack. A surprise attack from hiding counts double.
rows.action.double: Hit an adjacent enemy twice in one attack.
rows.action.charge: Charge up to 6 tiles in a straight line. Stun adjacent enemies at your destination for 2 turns.
rows.action.missile: Deal magic damage. Always hits and ignores resistance.
rows.action.sap: Deal physical damage and Stun for 3 turns (6 if unaware).
rows.action.shadowstep: Hide for 5 turns and break pursuit.
rows.action.ironbody: Gain armor and a chance for unarmed hits to Stun for 12 turns. Instant.
rows.action.bellow: Strike every enemy within 3 tiles with your main-hand weapon and stun them for 2 turns.
rows.action.unholyaura: For 8 turns, deal shadow damage each turn to enemies within 2 tiles. Heal for each enemy hit.
rows.action.lunge: Move beside an enemy within 4 tiles and attack with your main hand. Stun for 2 turns.
rows.action.temper: Gain weapon damage and armor for 12 turns. Instant.
rows.action.arcanelance: Deal magic damage to one enemy within 5 tiles.
rows.action.rolldice: Trigger a random reward or prank.
rows.action.intothedark: Hide for 5 turns and break pursuit. Your next hit from hiding deals {prayers:intothedark.effects.1.magnitude.scaled.per.rank|xn}% more damage{per}.
rows.action.firebolt: Burn one enemy. Ignites grass; destroys thorns.
rows.action.spark: Hit one enemy, with a chance to Stun. +50% damage to Wet targets.
rows.action.smite: Hit one enemy, with a chance to Blind. +50% damage to undead and shadow creatures.
rows.action.fireball: Blast a visible tile, burning everything within 2 tiles of it.
rows.action.frostcone: Chill and push enemies ahead of you.
rows.action.earthquake: Damage nearby creatures. Hits your summons; does not hit you.
rows.action.radiantbeam: Fire a beam through enemies. +50% damage to undead and shadow creatures.
rows.action.shadowswarm: Place a group of melee attackers. Replaces your previous swarm.
rows.action.livingflame: Summon a ranged attacker. Damages adjacent enemies on arrival; every third shot splashes for half damage.
rows.action.glacialtomb: Disable one enemy and make it immune to damage. Self-cast: 3 turns, then restore 25% max HP and Mana.
rows.action.stormform: Become living lightning: double movement, attack and casting speed.
rows.action.upheaval: Raise a barrier across your aim, centred on the chosen square. Hits your summons; does not hit you.
rows.action.dawn: Reveal every enemy on the floor and blind the ones you can see.
rows.action.umbral: Teleport to an explored tile and leave a melee shadow. Requires no adjacent enemies at the destination.
rows.action.ironhide: Gain armor and a damage shield.
rows.action.pummel: Strengthen your next 3 successful unarmed hits; each can Stun.
rows.action.rampage: Fight faster and hit harder in melee.
rows.action.trollblood: Restore HP, cleanse harmful statuses and regenerate HP. Regeneration stops while Rotted.
rows.action.consecrate: Cleanse yourself and strike nearby undead and shadow creatures.
rows.action.sanctuary: Heal allies and damage enemies in the area. Double damage against undead and shadow creatures.
rows.action.laststand: Reduce incoming damage and regenerate HP. Regeneration stops while Rotted.
rows.action.luckystreak: Retry one failed combat roll per turn. Shared by attacks, defense, gear and elemental procs.
rows.action.the-brood: Summon spiderlings whose bites web or poison. Replaces your previous brood.
rows.action.bonespear: Pierce every enemy in a line. Must leave at least 1 HP.
rows.action.manaward: A shield whose absorbed damage restores Mana. Refreshes the shield.
rows.action.arcaneblink: Teleport to visible, empty walkable ground.
rows.action.raisedead: Call an undead servant. Cannot summon while your servant still stands.
rows.action.fieldsmelt: Recycle one carried item for its full Essence value. Requires being out of combat.
rows.action.anviltoll: Strike all nearby enemies with your weapon, knocking them back and stunning them.
rows.action.lance: Attack enemies in a beam with your main hand.
rows.action.rolldice2: Tempt Wobbles for a greater reward, or a nastier prank.
rows.stat-passive.Crushing Blows: +25% weapon damage to targets below half HP.
rows.stat-passive.Spell Ward: Block spells and abilities. Without a shield: 33% block chance, up to 40% with Might.
rows.stat-passive.Cleaving Swings: Attacks hit one other adjacent enemy for half damage.
rows.stat-passive.Unstoppable: Immune to Stun, Root, Chill, Freeze, slows and knockback. +20% melee damage.
rows.stat-passive.Deadeye: +8% crit chance and +25% crit damage for attacks and spells.
rows.stat-passive.Keen Aim: Attacks ignore 25% evasion. +25% crit damage for attacks and spells.
rows.stat-passive.Blur: Enemy attacks are 20% less likely to hit you.
rows.stat-passive.Resilient: Double HP regeneration below half HP.
rows.stat-passive.Fortitude: Halve a hit that damages HP. 6-turn cooldown.
rows.stat-passive.Bulwark: Immune to critical hits. +5% nonphysical resistance.
rows.stat-passive.Tidal Mind: Double mana regeneration below half mana.
rows.stat-passive.Archmage: +10% spell damage, +5% crit chance, +20% max mana.
rows.boon.iron-flesh: +{boons:iron-flesh.effects.0.add.scaled.per.rank|xn} armor, +{boons:iron-flesh.effects.2.speedUpPct.scaled.per.rank|xn}% movement speed and +{boons:iron-flesh.effects.1.pct.scaled.per.rank|xn}% evasion{per}. Fists gain damage with rank and can parry.
rows.boon.staggering-blows: Unarmed hits have a {boons:staggering-blows.effects.0.chance}% chance to stun for 1 turn, and you punch {boons:staggering-blows.effects.1.speedUpPct.scaled.per.rank|xn}% faster{per}.
rows.boon.living-mountain: Unarmed attacks add a stack, even on misses (max 10). Each gives +2% crit, +2% accuracy and +2 damage. Attacks refresh all stacks for 6 turns; Holy Symbols extend this.
rows.boon.thick-hide: +{boons:thick-hide.effects.0.add.scaled.per.rank|xn|abs}% resistance to magic and elemental damage and +{boons:thick-hide.effects.7.pct.scaled.per.rank|xn}% HP regeneration{per}.
rows.boon.wizard-hunter: Taking magic, elemental or ranged damage grants +{statuses:wizardhunter.while.0.speedUpPct.scaled.per.rank|xn}% movement and attack speed{per} for 3 turns.
rows.boon.warriors-discipline: Taking HP damage builds up to 5 stacks, once per turn. Each grants weapon damage, crit and armor and reduces remaining cooldowns by 1. Stacks last 8 turns.
rows.boon.mending-light: +{boons:mending-light.effects.0.mult.scaled.per.rank|xn|pct}% healing and HP regeneration{per}, and +{boons:mending-light.effects.1.pct.scaled.per.rank|xn}% weapon damage{per} against undead and shadow creatures.
rows.boon.kindled: +1 Light affinity, outside your affinity cap. Needs a free element slot, unless you already hold Light.
rows.boon.life-drain: +{boons:life-drain.effects.0.chance.scaled.per.rank|xn}% Life Drain chance{per}, on top of Shadow's {boons:life-drain.effects.0.chance.scaled.per.affinity:shadow}% per point. Life Drain deals {boons:life-drain.effects.0.effects.0.amount|lo}-{boons:life-drain.effects.0.effects.0.amount|hi} shadow damage x Divine Power and heals what it deals.
rows.boon.grave-strength: Summons gain your weapon enchantment, Life Drain, and +{boons:grave-strength.effects.0.pct.scaled.per.rank|xn}% HP, movement speed, attack speed and damage{per}. Their healing restores their own HP.
rows.boon.lich: Your servant becomes a Lich and revives once, after 1 turn, at half HP. Gain +2% Divine Power per Vitality above 10.
rows.boon.fair-fight: +2 accuracy, +2% critical chance and +1 armor per god rank.
rows.boon.cowards-mark: Damaging ranged attacks Fear and Root their attacker for 3 turns.
rows.boon.perfect-counter: Counter every hostile attack, whether it hits or misses, with your main hand.
rows.boon.second-heat: Enchanting or carving a sigil has a 30% chance to give its motes back, rising to 50% at rank 5.
rows.boon.masterwork: Forge upgrades cost 30% less, and gear can be raised to +4.
rows.boon.repelling-force: Weapon hits and single-target spells have a {boons:repelling-force.effects.0.chance.scaled.per.rank|xn}% chance{per} to knock the enemy back 2 tiles.
rows.boon.perfect-invocation: Gain Spell Power equal to half your bonus Divine Power.
rows.boon.arcane-attunement: The bonuses and enchantments on your gear are 25% stronger.
rows.boon.lady-luck: +{boons:lady-luck.effects.0.add.scaled.per.rank|xn} percentage points{per} to crit, evasion, parry, block, gear and elemental proc chances.
rows.boon.favorite-toy: Wobbles sometimes turns a prank into a reward.
rows.boon.last-laugh: Survive a killing blow at 1 HP once per floor.
rows.boon.web-on-hit: Each hit has a {boons:web-on-hit.effects.0.chance.scaled.per.rank|xn}% chance{per} to web the target, which Roots it for 1 turn, slows it by half for 3 more and makes it Bleed.
rows.boon.venomtouch: Weapon, bow and spell hits against a target already under a status deal +{boons:venomtouch.effects.0.effects.0.amount.scaled.per.rank|xn} poison{per} and Poison it for 3 turns.
rows.boon.long-patience: Every status you inflict lasts 1 turn longer.

rows.gift.water.name: Ice Armor
rows.gift.air.name: Tailwind
rows.gift.earth.name: Stoneskin
rows.gift.light.name: Smite

rows.encyclopedia.attribute.Might: Each point above 10 adds {tuning:weapon-damage.mightPerPointPct}% to your weapon damage bonus, including ranged weapons. Each point above 10 also adds 2 percentage points to shield block chance, up to its cap. Might meets requirements for heavier weapons and armor.
rows.encyclopedia.attribute.Agility: Each point adds 2 accuracy and 2 evasion. Each point above 10 adds 2 percentage points of critical chance. Each point above 10 also makes attacks, spells and other actions 2% faster; movement is not affected. Agility also improves parrying, stealth and trap or secret spotting, and meets requirements for light weapons and bows.
rows.encyclopedia.attribute.Vitality: Raises maximum HP with your level. Each point above 10 adds 1 percentage point of nonphysical resistance and {progression:regeneration.hpPerVitalityPct|f2}% of maximum HP to normal regeneration per world turn. Vitality meets requirements for armor, shields and sacred equipment.
rows.encyclopedia.attribute.Focus: Raises maximum Mana with your level. Each point above 10 adds 4% to your spell damage bonus and {progression:regeneration.manaPerFocusPct|f2}% of maximum Mana to regeneration per world turn. Focus meets requirements for spellcasting equipment and cloth robes.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.HP: Health remaining. Reaching zero ends the run. Before bonuses, maximum HP is 10 + Vitality × (1 + level ÷ 5), rounded. Shields absorb eligible damage before HP.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Mana: Spent by spells and some abilities. Before bonuses, maximum Mana is Focus × (1 + level ÷ 5), rounded up. Mana regenerates as world time passes.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.HP regeneration: Normal recovery starts at {progression:regeneration.hpBasePct|f2}% of maximum HP per world turn, plus {progression:regeneration.hpPerVitalityPct|f2}% per Vitality above 10. Normal recovery pauses during combat, starvation, Poison and Rot. Other healing sources have their own conditions.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Mana regeneration: Normal recovery starts at {progression:regeneration.manaBasePct|f2}% of maximum Mana per world turn, plus {progression:regeneration.manaPerFocusPct|f2}% per Focus above 10. Focus passives and equipment can improve this.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Damage per hit: Weapon damage after Might and other unconditional bonuses, before the target’s defenses. Critical hits, surprise, elemental effects and bonuses against particular targets can change the result.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Accuracy: Improves the chance that an attack lands against the target’s Evasion. Base accuracy is {progression:player-base-stats.accuracyBase} + twice Agility, before equipment and other effects.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Evasion: Reduces attackers’ chance to hit. Base evasion is {progression:player-base-stats.evasionBase} + twice Agility, before armor, passives and other effects.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Hit chance: The ordinary attack chance is {tuning:to-hit.basePct}% + {tuning:to-hit.perPointPct}% × (Accuracy − {tuning:to-hit.accuracyPivot}) − {tuning:to-hit.perPointPct}% × (Evasion − {tuning:to-hit.evasionPivot}), limited to {tuning:to-hit.minPct}–{tuning:to-hit.maxPct}%. Abilities, statuses and special defenses may modify this.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Crit: Critical-hit chance starts at {progression:player-base-stats.critBasePct}%, plus {progression:player-base-stats.critPerAgilityPct} percentage points per Agility above 10. Equipment, passives and effects can add to it.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Crit damage: A critical hit normally deals ×{tuning:critical.playerMultBase|f2} damage. Agility 15 and Agility 21 each add {tuning:critical.agility15Bonus} to that multiplier. Some equipment and powers change it further.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Armor: Ordinary physical hits first lose half your armor, rounded up, to a maximum of half the incoming hit. Armor then reduces the remaining damage by {tuning:armour.pctPerArmour}% per point, up to {tuning:armour.pctCap}%. Heavy attacks bypass the first flat reduction. Armor piercing reduces effective armor.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Block: Chance to block an eligible attack. Shields add their own block chance, 2 percentage points per upgrade, and 2 per Might above 10, normally capped at 75%. Spell Ward expands what you can block.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Parry: A separate defense against eligible melee attacks. Wielding an off-hand weapon gives {progression:player-base-stats.parryBasePct}% + Agility ÷ 3 percentage points of parry chance. Some powers grant other ways to parry.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Spell power: Multiplies spell damage. Focus and its passives form the character bonus; casting equipment adds its own bonuses.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Divine power: Strengthens divine invocations and prayers according to each ability’s rules. Sacred equipment provides the basic bonus; individual gods can alter it. It is separate from Spell power.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Range: The reach of an attack or spell in tiles. Bows have their own range; spears reach two tiles in a line. Race, equipment and individual powers can extend range.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Attack speed: How quickly attacks, spells and other actions spend world time. Each point of Agility above 10 makes them 2% faster. Movement has its own speed.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Move speed: How quickly steps spend world time. Higher speed gives enemies less time between your steps. Agility does not change it.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Casting speed: How quickly casting spends world time. Agility speeds casting as it speeds attacks; an Air tome, spell timing and special effects can change it further.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Stealth: Reduces the chance an unaware enemy notices you. Agility, class, armor and special effects affect stealth; distance also matters. Enemies already hunting you are not made unaware by a higher stealth score.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Trap and secret spot: Your chance to notice hidden hazards or doors while exploring. Agility and some equipment improve discovery. Deliberate searching can reveal what ordinary movement missed.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Cooldowns: An ability may need time before it can be used again, even if you can pay its resource cost. The ability’s description states its cooldown and whether it is measured in world time or paid actions.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Resistances: Reduce damage of their listed type: Fire, Frost, Lightning, Poison, Light, Shadow and Magic. A positive percentage reduces damage; a negative one means vulnerability. Immunity prevents that damage type. Physical damage is handled by armor and other physical defenses.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Shields, Guard and I: Protective pools can absorb damage without losing HP. They have separate capacities, recharge rules and eligible damage types.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.XP and level: Experience advances your level and awards stat points. The level cap is 20.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Hunger: Falls as world time passes. Food restores it, up to the maximum. Starvation stops normal HP regeneration and eventually harms you.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Affinity and its cap: Affinity measures your investment in an element. You can hold at most two elements, never opposites. A secondary element cannot exceed the primary. Boss cores raise the total affinity cap.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Piety, rank and Favo: Piety is lasting progress with the current god; rank unlocks rewards. Favor is the separate resource spent on prayers and is capped at 100.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Amusement: Wobbles’ separate measure of interest in your actions, from 0 to 100. It can influence his interventions. It is separate from Piety and Favor.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Essence: Currency used for equipment upgrades, sigil crafting, purchases and other services. It belongs to the current run.
rows.encyclopedia.combat.Depth: The deepest main-dungeon floor reached. Visiting a side plane does not create an extra numbered dungeon floor.

rows.stat-gear.groups: heavy weapons=longsword axe mace; light weapons=sword dagger; spears=spear; bows=bow; heavy armor=plate chain; leather armor=leather; robes=robe; bucklers=buckler; kite shields=kite; spellcasting gear=staff wand orb tome; holy symbols=holy; ceremonial knives=censer
rows.floor-note.puzzle.poisonvault: Poison gas vault. Gas deals 8 poison damage per tick and poisons you for 3 turns on entry. A Firestorm sigil lies just inside; fire clears the gas, or Stone Skin protects you while you cross.
rows.floor-note.puzzle.offering: Offering chamber. A green flame burns above an offering bowl. Leave five pieces of gear or sigils at its feet to receive transmutation.
rows.floor-note.puzzle.chasm: Chasm vault: levitation crosses the gap.
rows.floor-note.puzzle.drowned: Drowned cellar: cold water hurts; levitate across.
rows.floor-note.puzzle.hoard: Frozen hoard: Fire melts the ice.
rows.floor-note.puzzle.everburn: Everburning door: Water puts out the flames.
rows.floor-note.puzzle.spikes: Spike gauntlet. Spikes cover the floor. Stone skin would shrug them off; floating would carry you over.
rows.floor-note.crystal-vault: Crystal vault: find key; choose one treasure.
rows.floor-note.treasury: Elemental treasury. A sealed treasure room requires {cost} {element} mote{cost|s}. All its treasures are yours once opened.
rows.floor-note.sanctuary: {element|cap} sanctuary: three tier {tier} elementalings guard a chest.
rows.floor-note.dark: Dark room: Light or Fire reveals it.
rows.floor-note.zoo: Locked zoo: packed with sleeping monsters.
rows.floor-note.goblin-mine: An abandoned goblin mine lies ahead. Mining gear surrounds a fire pit; the ground is unstable.
rows.floor-note.heroes-tomb: A hidden hero's tomb offers a consecrated refuge.
rows.floor-note.ossuary: An ossuary: the walls are bones.
rows.floor-note.flooded-crypt: A flooded crypt: grave ooze stands over the floor.
rows.floor-note.choir-loft: A choir loft: the dead are sung to here.
rows.floor-note.chaos-islands: Chaos: paired portals link five islands. Final current leads deeper.
rows.floor-note.treasure-room: A quiet treasure room lies beneath the twentieth floor. Gather supplies and prepare at the forge before entering Chaos.
rows.floor-note.crucible: Unmaker's Crucible: safe until you open the gate.
rows.floor-note.crucible-review: Combat is disabled in this environment review. Open the entrance gate to explore; Sandbox can raise both gates for a walkthrough.
rows.floor-note.crucible-gate: Entrance gate seals behind you. Defeat all three forms to reach the Forge.

rows.journal.gear.quality: Equipment comes in Worn, Plain, Fine and Masterwork quality. Each quality has its own base values and requirements. Upgrades are separate, up to +3.
rows.journal.gear.hands: Two-handed main weapons occupy both hands. Light one-handed weapons can go in the off hand; an off-hand weapon strikes at {tuning:weapon-damage.offhandMult|pct}% damage. The ranged slot carries a bow. Unidentified finds hide their upgrade, curse and enchantment details until learned.
